description: Compare two cars by their US recall record: distinct NHTSA recall campaigns since 2012, do-not-drive and park-outside campaigns, and a 0-100 recall load, plus the campaign count for one model year when a year is given. Counts, not a safety rating.

a.description: First car as make/model or make/model/year in lower case with hyphens, e.g. toyota/rav4/2019.

b.description: Second car, same form, e.g. honda/cr-v/2019.

name: compare_vehicles
